title: Large Language Models for Agentic NetOps and AIOps: Architectures, Evaluation, and Safety
abstract: arXiv:2605.12729v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used in network operations (NetOps) and artificial intelligence for IT operations (AIOps) for tasks ranging from telemetry retrieval and incident diagnosis to configuration planning and bounded remediation. As these systems acquire greater access to operational tools, the central question is no longer only what an LLM can do, but whether operational assurance increases commensurately with the authority granted to it. This survey examines that question through a structured, evidence-stratified review of agentic NetOps and AIOps. We organise the field around autonomy, tool scope, evidence traces, assurance controls, evaluation, security, and governance, and introduce an operational assurance contract that links each autonomy level to permitted tools, required evidence, independent gates, execution budgets, rollout and rollback duties, and audit requirements. translated_title: 面向智能体化网络运维与智能运维的大语言模型：架构、评估与安全
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正日益被应用于网络运维和IT智能运维中，承担从遥测数据检索、事件诊断到配置规划和受限修复等各类任务。随着这些系统获得对运维工具更大的访问权限，核心问题不再仅仅是LLM能做什么，而是运维保障水平是否随着赋予它的权限而相应提升。本综述通过对智能体化NetOps和AIOps的结构化、证据分层综述来考察这一问题。我们围绕自主性、工具范围、证据轨迹、保障控制、评估、安全和治理来组织该领域的研究，并引入一种运维保障契约，将每个自主性级别与允许使用的工具、所需证据、独立关卡、执行预算、发布与回滚职责以及审计要求相关联。
tldr: 本综述提出了一种“运维保障契约”框架，将大语言模型智能体在网络运维中的每个自主性级别与允许的工具、所需证据、独立关卡、执行预算和审计要求相绑定，以确保运维保障随授权程度相应提升。
en_tdlr: This survey introduces an operational assurance contract framework that binds each autonomy level of LLM agents in NetOps and AIOps to permitted tools, required evidence, independent gates, execution budgets, and audit requirements, ensuring operational assurance scales commensurately with granted authority.
